description: This PHP class 'SystemCheck' performs various system environment and configuration checks for the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system, including PHP version, database compatibility, server environment, directory permissions, and extension availability.

classes.name: SystemCheck
classes.description: A utility class for performing comprehensive system environment and configuration checks during installation or setup of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: isPHPVersionCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the current PHP version is within the allowed range.

methods.name: isMySqlClientCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the MySQL client version meets the minimum requirement.

methods.name: isMySqlServerCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the MySQL server version is within the supported range.

methods.name: isInnoDBSupport
methods.description: Checks if InnoDB engine is supported and enabled in the database.

methods.name: isWebServerCompatible
methods.description: Verifies if the web server software matches supported types.

methods.name: isWritableConfigDir
methods.description: Checks write permission for the configuration directory.

methods.name: isWritableCacheDir
methods.description: Checks write permission for the cache directory.

methods.name: isWritableLogDir
methods.description: Checks write permission for the log directory.

methods.name: isWritableCryptoKeyDir
methods.description: Checks write permission for the cryptokeys directory.

methods.name: isMaximumSessionIdle
methods.description: Checks the maximum session idle time before timeout.

methods.name: isRegisterGlobalsOff
methods.description: Verifies that register_globals PHP setting is turned off.

methods.name: getAllocatedMemoryStatus
methods.description: Checks the memory allocated for PHP scripts.

methods.name: isCurlEnabled
methods.description: Checks if cURL extension is enabled.

methods.name: isSimpleXMLEnabled
methods.description: Checks if SimpleXML extension is enabled.

methods.name: isZipExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if ZIP extension is enabled.

methods.name: isGdExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if GD extension is enabled.

methods.name: isIntlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if Intl extension is enabled.

methods.name: checkPDOExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if PDO extension is loaded.

methods.name: checkPDOMySqlExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if PDO MySQL extension is loaded.

methods.name: isLDAPExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if LDAP extension is enabled.

methods.name: isOpenSSLExtensionEnabled
methods.description: Checks if OpenSSL extension is enabled.

methods.name: checkWritePermission
methods.description: Attempts to write and delete a temp file in the specified directory to verify write permissions.

methods.name: checkPhpMemory
methods.description: Checks the current PHP memory limit against specified thresholds.

methods.name: getSizeInBytes
methods.description: Converts PHP memory size strings to bytes.

methods.name: isWithinRange
methods.description: Checks if a version string is within a specified range and not excluded.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message based on version compatibility.

methods.name: isExcluded
methods.description: Checks if a version is in the excluded range.

methods.name: getPhpVersion
methods.description: Returns current PHP version.

methods.name: getWebServerDetails
methods.description: Returns server software details.

methods.name: getMysqlClientVersion
methods.description: Returns MySQL client version.

methods.name: getMysqlServerVersion
methods.description: Returns MySQL server version.

methods.name: getMySqlHostInfo
methods.description: Returns MySQL connection status info.

methods.name: getOSDetails
methods.description: Returns server OS details.

methods.name: getPDOConnection
methods.description: Retrieves PDO connection object.

methods.name: getSystemDetails
methods.description: Returns overall system environment details.

methods.name: getSystemCheckResults
methods.description: Returns a structured array of all system checks and their results.
